failure_modes.name: Query_Form_Mismatch
failure_modes.evidence: Hop 2 query: 'Did Kamal Haasan work with director K. Balachander, who directed "Sundara Swapnagalu"?' — This is formulated as a natural-language yes/no question rather than a retrieval query targeting an entity or document.

failure_modes.name: Query_Stagnation
failure_modes.evidence: Hop 2 query asks 'Did Kamal Haasan work with director K. Balachander' when summary_1 already confirmed 'Kamal Haasan starred in multiple films directed by K. Balachander, including "Sollathaan Ninaikkiren" (1973), "Aakali Rajyam" (1981), and "Punnagai Mannan" (1986).' The query re-asks an already-answered question, and hop 2 retrieval returns largely duplicate documents from hop 1 (Sollathaan Ninaikkiren, Sundara Swapnagalu, Aakali Rajyam, Punnagai Mannan all repeat).

failure_modes.name: Solver_Irrelevant_Passage_Overprocessing
failure_modes.evidence: Hop 3 retrieved 10 documents about longevity claims, galaxies, query languages, and databases (Longevity claims, Abell 1835 IR1916, Moloko Temo, Hryhoriy Nestor, Mounir Fourar, Dextronaut, Facebook Query Language, List of British supercentenarians, Web search query, Dynaset) — all completely irrelevant to the claim about Kamal Haasan and film directors. These documents were retrieved and included in the final output despite having no connection to the verification task.
